select id,account_id accountId,name,description, avatar_id avatarId,voice_id voiceId,system_prompt systemPrompt,status,revision,auth_epoch authEpoch from p_application where id=#{applicationId} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='USER' and status!='DELETED' for update

select cast(x.skill_id as char) skillId,x.sort_order sortOrder, s.name,s.skill_type skillType,s.tool_name toolName from p_application_skill x join p_skill s on s.id=x.skill_id where x.application_id=#{applicationId} order by x.sort_order,x.id
select request_hash requestHash,resource_id resourceId from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{accountId} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{requestId} for update

select count(*) from p_avatar a join p_avatar_version v on v.id=a.current_version_id where a.id=#{avatarId} and a.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and v.status='PUBLISHED' and (a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.visibility='PRIVATE' or a.visibility='OFFICIAL') for update

select count(*) from p_voice voice join p_voice_version v on v.id=voice.current_version_id join p_official_service s on s.id=v.official_service_id where voice.id=#{voiceId} and voice.visibility='OFFICIAL' and voice.status='PUBLISHED' and v.service_type='OFFICIAL' and s.capability='TTS' and s.status='ACTIVE' for update

select cast(s.id as char) skillId,s.skill_type skillType, s.tool_name toolName from p_skill s where s.id=#{skillId} and s.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and (s.account_id=#{accountId} and s.visibility='PRIVATE' or s.visibility='OFFICIAL') for update

select cast(s.id as char) skillId,s.name,s.skill_type skillType,s.tool_name toolName, s.visibility from p_skill s where s.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and (s.account_id=#{accountId} and s.visibility='PRIVATE' or s.visibility='OFFICIAL') order by s.name,s.id

select count(*) from p_application a join p_avatar avatar on avatar.id=a.avatar_id join p_avatar_version av on av.id=avatar.current_version_id join p_voice voice on voice.id=a.voice_id join p_voice_version vv on vv.id=voice.current_version_id join p_official_service official on official.id=vv.official_service_id where a.id=#{applicationId} and av.status='PUBLISHED' and avatar.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and voice.visibility='OFFICIAL' and voice.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and vv.service_type='OFFICIAL' and official.capability='TTS' and official.status='ACTIVE' and not exists (select 1 from p_application_skill x join p_skill s on s.id=x.skill_id where x.application_id=a.id and s.status not in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED'))
select v.id from p_avatar a join p_avatar_version v on v.id=a.current_version_id where a.id=#{avatarId} and v.status='PUBLISHED' and (a.account_id=#{accountId} or a.visibility='OFFICIAL')
select v.id from p_voice voice join p_voice_version v on v.id=voice.current_version_id where voice.id=#{voiceId} and voice.visibility='OFFICIAL' and voice.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED')
select fallback_voice_version_id from p_voice_version where id=#{version}
mapper.update: update p_resource_reference set state='RELEASED',released_at=utc_timestamp(3),updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and holder_type='APP_CURRENT' and holder_id=#{applicationId} and state in ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED')
mapper.insert: insert into p_resource_reference (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,holder_type,holder_id,operation_id,resource_type,resource_id,state,confirmed_at) values (#{id},#{now},#{now},#{accountId},'APP_CURRENT',#{applicationId},#{operationId},#{resourceType},#{resourceId},'CONFIRMED',#{now}) on duplicate key update account_id=values(account_id),operation_id=values(operation_id),state='CONFIRMED', confirmed_at=values(confirmed_at),released_at=null,updated_at=values(updated_at)
mapper.update: update p_application set status=#{status},auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1, updated_at=utc_timestamp(3),revision=revision+1 where id=#{applicationId} and revision=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.insert: insert into p_outbox (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,event_id,event_type,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,schema_version,trace_id,payload,status,next_run_at) values (#{id},#{now},#{now},#{accountId},#{eventId},'APPLICATION_STATUS_CHANGED','APPLICATION',#{aggregateId},1, #{eventId},cast(#{payload} as json),'PENDING',#{now})
mapper.select: select cast(a.id as char) avatarId,a.name,a.visibility from p_avatar a join p_avatar_version v on v.id=a.current_version_id where v.status='PUBLISHED' and a.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and (a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.visibility='PRIVATE' or a.visibility='OFFICIAL') order by a.updated_at desc,a.id desc

select cast(voice.id as char) voiceId,voice.name,v.voice_code voiceAlias from p_voice voice join p_voice_version v on v.id=voice.current_version_id join p_official_service s on s.id=v.official_service_id where v.service_type='OFFICIAL' and voice.visibility='OFFICIAL' and voice.status='PUBLISHED' and s.capability='TTS' and s.status='ACTIVE' order by voice.updated_at desc,voice.id desc
